description: Every tool one of your agents has, with its input schema: reading its account and fills, placing and closing orders on Lighter and Hyperliquid (decide), swaps and lending on Robinhood Chain, moving money between venues, writing its standing strategy (set_strategy), making markets (set_quotes). Call any of them with call_agent_tools. Needs the owner's access key.

names_only.description: Only the names and descriptions, without schemas.
